Chirag Paswan on Nitish Setu Controversy: kendriy mantri aur lok janshakti parti (ramvilas) ke pramukh chirag pasvan (Chirag Paswan) ne raghopur-bidupur ke bich bane mahatvapurn pul ka nam 'nitish setu' (Nitish Setu) rakhe jane ke phaisle ka jordar svagat kiya hai. midiya se batchit karte hue chirag pasvan ne purv mukhyamantri nitish kumar (Nitish Kumar) ke vikas karyon ki sarahna karte hue kaha ki is setu ke lie unse behtar koee dusra nam nahin ho sakta tha.
